adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` is truthy, the function ignores the caller-provided `schema` and instead `safeParse`s with `minimumTokenResponseSchema`. That schema only requires `access_token` and (due to being a plain `z.object(...)` without `.passthrough()`) will strip any extra fields from the parsed `data`. Callers like `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts` rely on fields such as `instance_url` (enforced by `salesforceTokenSchema`) and then persist `accessTokenParsed.data` into `prisma.credential.update(...)`; under the sharing+endpoint condition, `instance_url` can be dropped even if present, causing persisted credentials to lose fields downstream code depends on (e.g., jsforce needing `instanceUrl`).
